base: black gesso, liquid clear, thin midnight black and prussian blue wash

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: quick criss-cross sky color
steps.rule: background color to start before the waterfall

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: blend the sky out
steps.rule: keep it light because things sit high in the sky

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: tap in dark distant trees

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: tap white tips onto distant trees
steps.where: far back, may run off canvas

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: tap in mist over the trees

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: tap in small floating clouds

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: soften clouds with the blender
steps.rule: more blending picks up the dark underneath so clouds fade

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: tap in background foliage trees
steps.rule: a waterfall needs a water source so foliage marks the river start

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: soften background trees

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: tap a forest of little trees
steps.load: a lot of the dark mix
steps.where: middle ground, both sides of the falls
steps.rule: a lighter cloud behind gives contrast so the trees show

steps.subject: land
steps.action: rub bank color on with the knife
steps.load: a little of each from a roll on the knife

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: pump bank color into bushes with the fan
steps.load: bank color picked up by a clean fan

steps.subject: stream
steps.action: paint lighter stream color with the knife
steps.rule: lighter so the water shows against the dark

steps.subject: waterfall
steps.action: drag falling water down the edge
steps.where: down over the edge to the base

steps.subject: waterfall
steps.action: highlight the falls with white
steps.load: a little white from the palette
steps.rule: so the falls show up better

steps.subject: waterfall
steps.action: let white water break over the edge
steps.load: pure white roll on the knife edge
steps.where: over the edge of the falls
steps.rule: easy to overdo it so stop before it gets too much

steps.subject: waterfall
steps.action: blend the spill over the edge
steps.where: over the edge of the falls

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: blend misty clouds at the base
steps.load: a little white on the blender
steps.rule: falling water makes mist at the base

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: paint big stones at the base

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: pull soft mist over the rocks
steps.motion: pull gently down over the rocks
steps.where: over the rocks at the base
steps.rule: a soft brush keeps from cutting the paint

steps.subject: waterfall
steps.action: let white water creep out of the mist
steps.motion: let it creep out and splash
steps.rule: liquid clear only thins the paint

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: tap highlights on some stones with the knife
steps.rule: keep the base dark so the contrast shows

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: paint dark little trees to close the falls
steps.load: dark mix with a little white

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: tap soft mist at the base

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: lay light color on the far stone
steps.motion: lay on top and pull down a little

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: blend the stone and mist together
steps.motion: blend the rocks and mist together
steps.rule: so you cannot tell where the mist stops

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: tap a big tree up in the mist
steps.load: little white on the fan brush

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: highlight the big tree with green
steps.load: sap green touch on the brush
steps.rule: dark trees show better with a bit of green

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: tap dark tree tops with sap green and yellow
steps.load: sap green with a little yellow
steps.rule: keep them dark because too bright looks wrong

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: dab a little green down low
steps.rule: just enough green to flavor it

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: tap lighter trees to vary the values
steps.load: lighter version of the dark mix

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: tap soft mist between the trees
steps.rule: mist separates the layers and makes it look deep

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: tap dark trees back in the middle
steps.load: dark mix with a little green

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: highlight the tops of the trees
steps.load: sap green with a little dark
steps.motion: tap highlights, darker toward the base

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: tap a dark tree up against the mist
steps.rule: mist lets the dark tree separate on its own

steps.subject: stream
steps.action: shine the water with white pulled down
steps.load: a little white on the fan brush

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: paint stones with the filbert
steps.load: thinned blue-black mix with white on one side
steps.motion: touch and pull one side through the light color
steps.where: along the river and in the water
